onboarding.step1Title: Your journey to a nicotine-free life starts here!
onboarding.step1Subtitle: Here's some information about the app and how it works.
onboarding.step1Info1: During this onboarding process, we'll ask a few questions about your nicotine habits. This information helps us create a personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs.
onboarding.step1Info2: Whether you smoke, use snus, or use other nicotine products, the app uses your answers to calculate a gradual and realistic tapering plan.
onboarding.step1Info3: The onboarding consists of a few simple steps, each containing a few short questions. The process only takes a couple of minutes to complete.
onboarding.step1Info4: If you want to change an answer from a previous step, you can always go back using the buttons at the bottom of the screen.
onboarding.step1Info5: Once you're done, your personalized treatment plan will be generated automatically.

tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.subtitle: By using this app, you agree to the following terms and conditions:
tos.1: Data Collection: We collect data on your nicotine consumption and treatment plan to provide you with personalized support and to improve our services. This data is stored securely and is not shared with third parties without your consent.
tos.2: Privacy: We are committed to protecting your privacy. Your data is anonymized and used only for the purposes of providing you with support and improving our services.
tos.3: User Responsibility: You are responsible for following the treatment plan provided by the app. The app is a tool to assist you in quitting nicotine, but it is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult with a healthcare provider before making any changes to your treatment plan.
tos.4: Limitation of Liability: We are not liable for any damages or losses that may occur as a result of using this app. The app is provided "as is" and we make no warranties or guarantees regarding its effectiveness.
tos.5: Changes to Terms: We reserve the right to update our Terms of Service at any time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Terms of Service on this page. You are advised to review this page periodically for any changes.

onboarding.step5subHeader: Here's a quick overview to help you get the most out of your tapering plan.
onboarding.featureCard1Para: The app calculates the time interval and sends a notification when it's time for your next dose.
onboarding.featureCard2Header: 2. Acute withdrawal? Use the red button
onboarding.featureCard2Para: In the menu bar, you'll find a red button with exercises and support for when cravings are at their strongest.
onboarding.featureCard3Para: You can view and adjust your tapering plan in your profile at any time.
onboarding.featureCard4Para: Register each snus pouch or cigarette in the app throughout the day.
onboarding.featureCard5Para: Keep track of your daily limits and see your progress in real time.
onboarding.featureCard6Para: Don't be afraid to use patches or gum when withdrawal symptoms hit.

nicotineHelp.title: How do I calculate the amount?
nicotineHelp.body:
Check the back of your snus can. Does it say something like 12 mg/g? A pouch usually weighs around 0.8 g. 

12 mg × 0.8 = 9.6 mg per pouch. 

If you use 10 of these per day, set the slider to 96 mg.

logDoseHelp.title: Withdrawal level when taking a dose
logDoseHelp.body: You can either enter how much withdrawal you're experiencing when you take your dose, OR log your dose WITHOUT entering a withdrawal level. In that case, only the time you take the dose will be logged.

profileSettingsHelp.title: Profile settings
profileSettingsHelp.body: Here you can change settings and personal details such as your name and email. You can also make changes to your treatment plan here!

systemSettingsHelp.title: System settings
systemSettingsHelp.body: Here you can configure settings such as language and appearance. Choose between light and dark themes, or why not try our 'Autumn' theme? There's something for everyone!

forumBasicHelp.title: The forum
forumBasicHelp.body: Here you can share tips and tricks that have worked for you in your struggle with withdrawal. The more people share their successes, the easier it becomes for others to succeed too! Choose a suitable category and start posting. Please follow common etiquette!

supportToolsHelp.title: Would you like to use support tools?
supportToolsHelp.body: We strongly recommend using support tools such as patches or gum, as they can increase your chances of success.
